control.name: CONTROL — Marked never honours a marker

mutations.name: #2684 review S1: CommentLed judges the whole cell, not the first span (a comment span after prose runs)
#2684 review F2: a cmd:-marked comment is exempt (the executors run what statusgen refuses)
#3147: Lift runs the whole unwrapped cell again ("`false`: confirm" runs as the : no-op)
mutations.old: func Lift(cell string) string { return briefdoc.VerifyCommand(cell) }
mutations.new: func Lift(cell string) string { return strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(cell), "`") }

mutations.name: #3147: a prose-led first span is no longer refused (the executors run a file mention statusgen refuses)
#3147: a blank lift is no longer refused (sh -c "" exits 0)
#3147 A2: the no-op is judged on the first span, not the lift (a marked : runs)
#3147 A2: a row built without a cell no longer refuses a no-op
Marked never honours a marker (the delegation to the shared scan is dropped)
